en: Color postcard showing a small white fairytale-like clock tower rising above a lush park with tall fir trees and flowerbeds of bright red blossoms. The reverse is laid out in Romanian as a standard "CARTE POSTALA," with a blue handwritten message and address, a Romanian 40 bani stamp (POSTA ROMANA), and postal cancellations. Printed caption at bottom left references Vatra Dornei.
